name: scripted-rate-limit-responses-in-mock-http
description: To twin-test transient-failure resilience: give the scripted mock HTTP client response-header support (MockRoute.response_headers + a with_res_header builder on the route just added) and classify 429/rate-limit-403 into a dedicated retryable error variant carrying the Retry-After hint; the bounded retry loop then takes a zero-second hint in tests so scripted rate windows retry instantly (work#1332 PR pipeline).

name: run-channel floor-probe fails-open fake-server pattern
description: Raw-TCP fake-server tests in fabro-client that assert on request lines must loop-accept until the expected request and 404 everything else: in run-channel sandboxes (FABRO_RUN_CHANNEL_TOKEN set) the one-shot send_api floor probe fires GET /api/v1/system/info before the test's own request, and the probe fails open on any error. Pin the in-run behavior by setting the env var inside a #[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods)]-annotated test (nextest runs one test per process, so the mutation cannot leak); remove the var on the way out. Applied in lib/foundation/fabro-client/src/client.rs (work#1354).
